title: Vitamux ingest batch v1
description: Body of POST /api/ingest/v1/batches. Frozen (Gate G3): only additive, optional changes within v1. Policy: docs/architecture/connectors.md#schemas-and-versioning.

migration_source.description: Set only by migration importers (E16), e.g. open_wearables.

connection_id.description: Connection the client token is scoped to: conn_ + the UUID as 32 lowercase hex characters.

item.description: One raw source record. Exactly one of body (inline JSON) or blob_sha256 (file uploaded to POST /batches/{id}/blobs).

stream.description: Source stream and its payload version, e.g. healthkit.samples.v1.

external_key.description: Stable key of the record within the stream. Same key + same content = duplicate; same key + new content = new raw version.

fetched_at.description: When the client read the record from its source; RFC 3339 with offset.

content_type.description: Media type of the verbatim source payload.

sha256.description: Optional lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of body as sent (or equal to blob_sha256); the server rejects a mismatch.

request.description: How the client fetched the record. Credentials are stripped by the server before storage; clients should not send them.

body.description: Verbatim source payload, stored byte for byte as sent.
